questions.stem: The owners of the Fizgig Manufacturing Company use a uniformly elastic demand curve where price \( p \) and quantity \( q \) satisfy \( pq = T \) for some constant turnover \( T \).
questions.hint: Write a full structured solution for the teacher to mark.

steps.explain: Solve for the quantity \( q \) given the new price \( p = \\(10 \).\)
Since \( q = \frac{T}{p} \), quantity is inversely proportional to price. Tripling the price divides the quantity by 3.
